{{Quote|Then came the Bordal Contagion of 214 BBY. I don't know what it was&mdash;some kind of plague that left people strangling on fluid in their lungs, awful stuff.|Firmus Kett mentions the contagion in his memoirs|<ref name="EGtW:AC" />}}
The '''Bordal Contagion''' was a [[plague]]-like disease which caused its victims to choke on fluid building up in their [[Lung/Legends|lungs]]. An outbreak of the disease occurred on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bordal]] in [[214 BBY]], prompting the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to develop an [[Bordal Contagion antidote|antidote]] on the planet [[Tauber]] and then begin shipping it to the planet [[Kabal/Legends|Kabal]], which was located near Bordal. The shipments however never reached their destination, as the [[Transport/Legends|transports]] carrying them were attacked and stripped for parts by the [[Fujari]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], who left the six million antidotes being carried to spoil. The Republic took no action against the Fujari, and eventually the [[Rseikharhl]] [[Species/Legends|species]] native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rseik]] near Bordal began manufacturing the antidote themselves for the Bordali, however by this time millions were already [[Death/Legends|dead]]. The [[Trade Defense Force]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Firmus Kett]] claimed in his [[Memoirs of Firmus Kett|memoirs]] that the events surrounding the contagion outbreak were a major factor in prompting the Rseikharhl and several other groups active in the nearby area to turn to the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] for aid in dealing with the local pirates.<ref name="EGtW:AC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Bordal Contagion was supposed to be first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', a sourcebook released in [[2012]] written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]], but they were ultimately cut from the final product. The section including the contagions was later published as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut]]'', a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|blog]] starting in [[2013]].
